title: OECD Digital Education Outlook 2026
discussion_signal: OECD’s discussion distinguishes quick task performance from durable learning and emphasizes that pedagogy, teacher agency, infrastructure, and trust determine whether generative AI helps education.
linked_research_question: Can generative AI improve educational task performance without producing learning unless pedagogy, teacher agency, infrastructure, and trust keep cognitive work visible?
limits: The post summarizes a report and does not provide school-level implementation evidence
It does not establish long-run learning outcomes
Institutional messaging may understate disagreement about classroom use
